task.title: To update a Favorite Filter
task.shortdesc: Rakesh Singh Open an app and click on a user menu button to retrieve data

step.cmd: Open an app and click on a user menu button to retrieve data that requires user input (Search & Select or Query).
Click on the Favorite Filter drop-down and select a Favorite Filter from the list.
Change the value or values of any filter for the action.
Click on the Favorite Filter drop-down and select Update.
Choose the updated Favorite Filter from the drop-down to use the updated filter.
